benchmark_dataset: Replica of published SKZ/Fraunhofer ProBayes DoE (DOI 10.23728/b2share.03133fb279294389a15baefd55e4257a) + own deterministic replay
key_findings: On the replica dataset, 97.96% of defective parts passed every individual machine parameter limit.
At the same false-alarm rate on good parts (0.43%), multivariate distance catches 9.18% of defects against 2.04% for univariate limits (4.5x).
Resin moisture is handled with a modelled non-linear penalty above 0.18% and a hard release gate at 0.15% -- an assumption, not a measurement.
Suspect-lot reduction figures come from our own dual-stream replay and are modelled, not observed in a plant.

test_cases.title: Defects Inside Tolerance: Univariate Limits vs Multivariate Distance
test_cases.empirical_reference: Replica of the published SKZ/Fraunhofer ProBayes DoE (564 parts, 98 defective)
test_cases.conventional_spc_behavior: Accepted 96 of 98 defective parts (97.96%) because every individual parameter stayed inside its tolerance band. Catch rate 2.04%.
test_cases.process_guardian_behavior: Hotelling T^2 distance from the good-part population, thresholded to stop the same share of good parts (0.43%), catches 9.18% of the same defects -- 4.5x more at identical operator cost, including 7 the machine limits accepted.
test_cases.evidence_summary: Univariate tolerance checking misses defects whose individual signals all sit inside their bands while the combination has moved. Both detectors were held to the same false-alarm rate on good parts, so the 4.5x gap is not bought by alarming more often. Deterministic replica reproducing the published experiment's design (part count, material split, varied set parameters, OK/NOK label structure). Not the original measured parts. Metrics are computed on the replica.
test_cases.citation: Injection-Molding Production Data with Quality Labels - ProBayes project, SKZ & Fraunhofer IPA (2022): 564 parts, 47 DoE points, PP & ABS | DOI 10.23728/b2share.03133fb279294389a15baefd55e4257a

test_cases.title: Non-Linear Hygroscopic Moisture Penalty (Model Assumption)
test_cases.empirical_reference: No public per-lot moisture/scrap dataset was used. The accelerating penalty above the 0.18% knee is OUR MODEL'S assumption, shaped by the standard polymer-drying practice that hygroscopic resins (PA, PBT) hydrolyse when moulded wet.
test_cases.conventional_spc_behavior: Machine controllers do not read hopper moisture at all, so no parameter limit can trip on it.
test_cases.process_guardian_behavior: Quality Risk applies a non-linear penalty above 0.18% moisture and the operational checkpoint blocks release above the 0.15% process gate, requiring a drying sign-off instead of a machine-parameter change.
test_cases.evidence_summary: Stated as a tunable model parameter, not a measured curve. Its value to a plant is the behaviour it drives: a moisture excursion is answered with drying and a sign-off, never by trimming machine settings to mask a raw-material problem.

test_cases.title: Constrained Intervention vs Doing Nothing (Our Own Replay)
test_cases.empirical_reference: Process Guardian's deterministic dual-stream replay: the identical event stream run with Guardian OFF and Guardian ON. This is our own simulation, not an industry study.
test_cases.conventional_spc_behavior: Guardian OFF: the line keeps running until downstream sorting finds the defective bin.
test_cases.process_guardian_behavior: Guardian ON: minimum-effective adjustment inside the 5-layer envelope, then a consecutive stability window and a physical QC checkpoint before the lot is released.
test_cases.evidence_summary: Measures the decision policy, not the world: it shows the loop closes and the suspect window collapses on identical inputs. Per-scenario figures come from the counterfactual replay the judge can re-run, so none are frozen into this report.

conclusion_for_evaluators: One comparison here is anchored to a published experiment's design; the rest is this system's own modelled behaviour, and each case says which it is. What the evidence supports is narrow and specific: checking parameters one at a time misses defects that a multivariate distance catches at the same false-alarm cost, and a constrained reaction policy closes the loop from that detection through verified recovery to a contained lot. What it does not support is any claim about scrap reduction on a real machine -- that needs a plant trial we have not run.
